name: example-client-plugin
description: A MindRoom client plugin for the tests: renders messages that carry com.example.greeting, adds two side panels, one whose rows, menu and dialog are the app's own and which shows a greeting's text as the app renders an agent's reply, and one that draws its own frame, a room header action, two slash commands and two room menu entries, one of them critical, shows a banner under the room header, whose words its build module writes in, and covers the conversation.
